findings.title: No mainnet date and no decided mainnet ordering
evidence: Founder statement, #validator-ops, 2026-09-18: mainnet ordering undecided, leaning toward the 'painful option', likely option 2 (mainnet on postfiatl1v2 with inherited validator governance after a multi-million-dollar audit). The 'painful option' was never explicitly named as option 2; that link is an inference, not a quotation.
Whitepaper (Sept 2026, outputs/postfiat-whitepaper.html): 0 hits for 'testnet', 'conversion', '1:1', 'carryover'. No mainnet date anywhere in the whitepaper text.

postfiatl1v2 docs/status/network-status.md (reviewed 2026-11-06): the only running network is the controlled devnet postfiat-wan-devnet-2; 'It is not a production mainnet, no public testnet is open' (for l1v2).
findings.gate: BLOCKS any cutover schedule. No date can be committed.

findings.title: No 1:1 testnet-to-mainnet conversion mechanism exists for the live testnet
evidence: No conversion, carryover, or 1:1 mechanism is published for the live postfiatd testnet (network 2025). The whitepaper contains no conversion text; postfiatd source contains no migration/carryover path (genesis is a fresh ledger: Ledger::Ledger(create_genesis_t), fixtures/source-excerpts/Ledger-genesis.txt).

The only documented 1:1 path is the l1v2 design: ERC-20 PFT on Base with a one-for-one path into native PFT at PFTL mainnet genesis via genesis external lanes (postfiatl1v2 docs/architecture/pft-token-on-base.md, genesis-external-lanes.md). It is a design for a different protocol (Consensus v2), not the live postfiatd testnet.
Nothing is deployed on Base mainnet; only Base Sepolia test deployments exist. The slice size of the 100B supply is open. Rehearsal lock released 2026-11-06 on a local six-validator fleet only.

Doc inconsistency: genesis-external-lanes.md names 0xe36e7fc384564419187546c19719a5654266de0b as the rehearsal lock, but pft-token-on-base.md says that address is the ARCHIVED lock ('never locked') and the rehearsal lock is 0xFb6CF3D7E759cB3130C094C1D7264619ecE74D73.
findings.gate: BLOCKS any balance-carryover claim. Testnet balances must be assumed lost at cutover until a mechanism is published.

findings.title: Amendment-dependent readiness is blocked: vote-replay test PR unmerged; PostFiat-native amendments not enabled
evidence: PR postfiatorg/postfiatd#53 'Test amendment vote replay with reordered validations': state=open, merged=False, mergeable_state=unstable, updated 2026-11-13T23:18:29Z (outputs/pr53-summary.json). The regression test proving amendment-vote outcomes do not depend on validation order has no merged CI proof.
fixAmendmentMajorityCalc IS enabled on testnet (67%% threshold active), but order-independence of vote replay remains unproven without PR #53.

PF_ValidatorVoteTracking and PF_AccountExclusion exist in code (features.macro lines 45-46) but are NOT enabled on testnet and are not in voting (outputs/derived/amendments.json). Vote tracking and account exclusion therefore cannot be exercised before cutover.
Testnet amendment majority time is 3 days (config) vs the 2-week code default; mainnet config carries no override, so mainnet amendments would take 2 weeks to activate.
findings.gate: BLOCKS amendment-gated cutover steps. Do not cut over on amendment behavior that has no merged regression test.

findings.title: No external audit of either codebase; migration/rollback gate open
evidence: postfiatl1v2 docs/security/index.md: 'No external security audit is recorded in this repository.' Release-gate inventory (2026-09-01): 21 gates, 4 DONE, 16 OPEN, 1 UNKNOWN. Gate 8 (migration, rollback, canary) OPEN; gate 20 (topology/independence thresholds) OPEN; gate 12 (specialist review) OPEN; gate 13 (SP1 reproduction) OPEN.
QA defect inventory: 142 rows (27 P1, 77 P2, 38 P3); fixes scoped per row, some in source but not deployed.
Launch-topology thresholds are a proposal only, awaiting the operator's confirmation (2026-09-01).
findings.gate: BLOCKS a production cutover. The founder's 'multi-million-dollar audit' is a statement, not a scoped engagement: no auditor, scope, or date is published.

findings.title: Mainnet quorum must change: testnet runs a 67% quorum the code says to revert to 80% for mainnet
evidence: ValidatorList::calculateQuorum returns max(ceil(effectiveUnlSize*0.67), ceil(unlSize*0.6)) with the comment: 'Use a 67%% quorum ... Original XRPL uses 80%%, but this fork uses 67%% for devnet/testnet. For mainnet, this should be reverted to 80%%.' (fixtures/source-excerpts/ValidatorList-quorum.txt).
Live check closes the loop: UNL 25 -> ceil(25*0.67)=17, ceil(25*0.6)=15, reported validation_quorum=17 (outputs/derived/validators.json quorum_check).
At 80%% a 25-member UNL needs 20 validations; the stale UNL member (F07) plus any second outage would leave 23 active, still above 20 — but no 80%% quorum has ever run on this network.
findings.gate: REQUIRED before mainnet: change the quorum constant, re-run the full amendment/consensus test battery, and re-measure liveness with the production UNL.

findings.title: UNL is centrally administered; no published mainnet UNL-transition procedure
evidence: Whitepaper: 'one organization administers the current validator fleet'; 'independently operated validators' is listed among the requirements that 'remain proposals'.

Shipped validators.txt (configs/) is a template with no validator keys and no validator_list_sites configured in either mainnet or testnet config; the live UNL is operator-supplied, not reproducible from the repo.

VHS derives the UNL from the admin `validators` RPC (docs/POSTFIAT.md); the public proxy blocks that method (HTTP 403, outputs/rpc-validators.json), so outside operators cannot independently fetch the UNL from RPC.

Mainnet config ships in-repo and differs from testnet only in network_id (2026), seed peers (rpc.mainnet.postfiat.org only), and the absence of the 3-day amendment-majority override (configs/config-diff-mainnet-vs-testnet.txt).
findings.gate: BLOCKS a decentralized cutover. The runbook (docs/runbook.md) is validated only against live testnet observations and the shipped configs.

findings.title: One UNL member is stale (0.00000 24h agreement); 12 non-UNL validators run old builds
evidence: UNL member paymuslam.top (key nHBxQ3srN8Er): 24h agreement 0.00000, current_index 8179976 vs network 8273715 at probe time (~93739 ledgers / ~3 days behind). 1 of 25 UNL members contributes nothing to current consensus.
UNL 24h missed validations total 38,365, dominated by the stale member.
12 of 66 validators (18%%) run older builds (1.0.4 x9, 1.0.8 x1, 1.0.0 x2); none is on the UNL. All 25 UNL members run 1.0.9 and all 25 domains are verified.
findings.gate: Cutover precondition: remove or repair the stale UNL member and re-measure UNL agreement before any mainnet UNL is frozen.

findings.title: Rollback against a real cutover is untested; no cutover has ever been performed
evidence: l1v2 release gate 8 (migration, rollback, canary) is OPEN; the 2026-10-30 l1v2 deployment record notes 'no rollback needed' — a rollback has never been exercised on either codebase in a cutover context.
The runbook (docs/runbook.md) rollback section is a procedure derived from config + live read-only behavior, not an executed drill.
postfiatd has no in-protocol rollback: a bad mainnet genesis cannot be 'rolled back' — it can only be abandoned and re-genesis'd, which destroys mainnet state created after genesis.
findings.gate: REQUIRED before cutover: a rehearsed rollback drill on a staging network with a published stop condition.

findings.title: Public observability gaps: explorer health failing, topology link count 0, WebSocket stream not publicly subscribable
evidence: explorer /api/v1/health returns HTTP 500 '{"message":"rippled unreachable"}' while /api/v1/metrics works (base_fee 0.00001, txn_sec 0.09, ledger_interval 3.022).
VHS topology reports node_count 72 but link_count 0, while per-node inbound/outbound sums are 690/710 — the aggregate contradicts the per-node data.
VHS /v1/network/networks still lists 2 webhook.site test entries alongside the real test network.
WebSocket ledger subscribe: :443 upgrade answered HTTP 401 'Invalid protocol.' (Caddy/postfiatd-1.0.9); :6005 gave no response within 15 s. Public monitoring depends on HTTP polling.
VHS health returns {"count":"8"} — an unexplained figure.
findings.gate: Cutover precondition: fix or document every observability gap; a cutover cannot be monitored on endpoints that report unreachable/0.

findings.title: Public validator counts disagree; homepage snapshot two months stale
evidence: Homepage snapshot Sep 21, 2026: 53 validators, 39 verified domains, 52 at 24h agreement 99.9%+, 6.5M ledger index. Live 2026-11-22: 66 validators, 55 verified domains, 63 at >=0.999, ledger 8,272,101 (outputs/derived/homepage-vs-live.json).
findings.gate: None for cutover; refresh the homepage snapshot before any public readiness claim.

findings.title: Cosmetic divergence: postfiatd still reports the native currency code as 'XRP' in source
evidence: SystemParameters.h systemCurrencyCode() returns "XRP" (fixtures/source-excerpts/SystemParameters.h.txt) while the asset is PFT. Ledger behavior is unaffected (amounts are drops of the native asset); only display/code strings are stale.
findings.gate: None for cutover; rename before mainnet to avoid integrator confusion.

findings.title: Verified healthy: genesis supply reconciles exactly; ledger advancing steadily; amendment state agrees across two independent sources
evidence: Genesis supply 100,000,000,000 PFT (INITIAL_XRP, SystemParameters.h:43) reconciles: genesis account holds 96,999,999,999.99988 PFT, other accounts hold 2999999966.558320 PFT, 33.441800 PFT burned in fees; sum closes exactly (outputs/derived/live-testnet-snapshot.json).
Cadence: 198 ledgers in 600 s of sampling, mean close interval 3.030 s (outputs/cadence-run1.jsonl). Fee queue empty (0/2000), base fee 10 drops, median fee 5000 drops.
Amendment state agrees across two independent sources: RPC `feature` reports 64 enabled of 101 known; VHS vote endpoint reports 64 enabled with identical names.
All 64 enabled amendments share one enablement point: ledger 86785, 2026-02-09T14:31:12Z (genesis-era bulk enablement).
Latest release v1.0.9 (2026-10-10) is the live build on all 25 UNL members and on the RPC node.
findings.gate: None. This is the evidence that the testnet itself is healthy; it does not imply mainnet readiness.
